falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 3.0% above its level on the verdict date and finishes the 14-day window at a new 20-day high, with NYSE advancing issues exceeding declining issues on at least 8 of those 14 sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A held breakout with confirming breadth invalidates both HOLD and the mini_top_2019_jun analogue: price resolved into continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes 6.0% or more below its level on the verdict date at any point in the next 14 days, with VIX closing above 25 on the same session.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A drawdown of that size with a volatility spike exceeds a June-2019-style mini-top pause and invalidates HOLD; the correct call would have been risk-off, not unknown.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern similarity to mini_top_2019_jun falls below 50% and the blowoff score moves outside 40-70 (either below 40 or above 70) before day 14, while the engine still has no phase label other than Unknown.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The quantitative basis for the current caution has broken and a phase should have been assigned; remaining UNKNOWN/HOLD after that shift proves the verdict failed to update.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
